mentions.name: Vibespace
mentions.description: A macOS workspace with containerized AI agent teams, free to use, aimed primarily at non-technical users. Users share their existing business and the platform spins up dedicated agent roles such as market researchers, content creators, and coders. The agents communicate with each other autonomously to build apps, automations, and more, and it works with existing Claude Code / Codex subscriptions.
mentions.problem: Non-technical teams struggle with capable yet complex agentic solutions.
mentions.audience: Primarily non-technical users and non-technical teams
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working on Vibespace (https://vibespace.build), a workspace with containerized AI agent teams. It is free on MacOS and lets primarily non-technical users to manage multiple agents that collaborate together.
